thread:
nora: Quick follow-up from today's runtime segment. Consolidating the three asks: exact SLOs for playbook, fallback semantics, and kernel-v4 canary gates. Keep replies short.
vince: For the playbook we should publish target windows for p50/p95/p99 and a short note about regional egress. I suggest infra propose numbers and product approves the public wording.
sam: +1. Internal proposal: hosted p50=20ms, p95=120ms, p99=400ms. Dedicated: p50=14ms, p95=80ms, p99=250ms. Measurement window: rolling 5m, exclude deploy warmups.
hema: fallback semantics: SLA routes must not be silently downgraded. Best-effort routes can auto-fallback to quantized-same or smaller-model variants. Every fallback must emit a trace and set X-Model-Fallback header.
michael: add X-Model-Fallback-Reason enum so automation can react (values: none, quantized, smaller_model, degraded_features). Don't leak internal model names in headers.
nora: agreed. Also require a console flag so org admins can hide/show fallback headers for privacy-conscious customers.
vince: batching question  clarify adaptive vs fixed. We propose per-worker adaptive microbatching with a per-route opt-out via X-Request-Priority header. Default target_latency_ms=60, worker_max_batch=64.
sam: ops note: add a spike circuit to avoid huge batch build-ups during traffic surges (e.g., cap queue time and fall back to immediate dispatch).
hema: KV cache: default TTL 5m, add hot-score extension up to 4x TTL bounded by per-tenant memory cap (default 5% node mem). Implement LRU with tenant fairness weights.
michael: ops will run a 10-day canary increasing hot-extend to 20m on two clusters and report p95 + cost delta. Success if p95 improves and cost delta < 7%.
vince: kernel-v4 gating: need numeric gates for perf, quality, and memory. Otherwise we can't automate rollouts.
sam: proposal for RFC gates: perf p95 regression < 5% vs baseline on sampled traffic; memory resident < +6%; quality sampled-eval delta < 1.0 on internal metric; determinism token-diff-rate < 0.2% on 5k prompt sample. Fail any -> auto-roll back.
hema: product wants a two-sentence customer blurb for release notes about best-effort fallbacks and SLA guarantees. I'll draft and post by EOD.
nora: thanks. Platform: add header + trace wiring to backlog. Also add per-route cache_hit_rate and eviction_rate to console metrics. Prioritize basic surfacing first.
michael: estimate: header + trace linkage ~1 sprint; console surfacing another sprint. Can do header quick if we avoid dashboard changes.
vince: action items recap: 1) infra lock SLO numbers after next perf sweep (sam) 2) ops run hot-extend experiment (michael) 3) platform add X-Model-Fallback header + telemetry (platform) 4) product publish two-sentence blurb (hema) 5) ben (not in thread) to publish kernel-v4 RFC with numeric gates (ben).
ops-bot: Meeting notes uploaded: https://redwood.internal/notes/allhands-2812345678. :white_check_mark:
nora: great, I'll follow up if we need to adjust thresholds. If anyone has objections to the fallback header or the SLOs, flag them here before EOD.
